subject: Genetics
title: Cancer Predisposition Genes
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cancer Predisposition Genes usable.

hook.text: Angelina Jolie carried BRCA1. It gave her an 87% breast cancer risk. She chose preventive mastectomy.

buildup.text: BRCA1 and BRCA2 repair damaged DNA. When broken, cells pile up errors that drive cancer growth.

discovery.text: About 1 in 400 people carry a BRCA mutation. In Ashkenazi Jews, it's 1 in 40—ten times higher.

twist.text: BRCA isn't a death sentence. Some carriers never get cancer. Modifiers, environment, and luck all play roles.

climax.text: Jolie's disclosure doubled BRCA testing rates globally. One person's choice changed millions of medical decisions.

punchline.text: One gene. 87% risk. She chose to act first.

quiz.question: What do BRCA1 and BRCA2 normally do?
